title: SBI PO Syllabus 2026 – Prelims & Mains
vacancyDetails: Prelims + Mains (Objective & Descriptive) + Psychometric / GE & Interview
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years (as per PO notification; relaxations apply)
selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Psychometric Test + Group Exercise & Interview → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF; keep notification for pattern updates
howToApply:
1. Visit https://sbi.bank.in Careers
2. Open PO notification PDF
3. Note Prelims/Mains structure and topics
4. Prepare banking awareness for Mains
5. Practice descriptive English on computer
shortDescription: SBI PO Syllabus 2026 – Prelims English, Quant, Reasoning; Mains with GA, DI, Reasoning-Computer and Descriptive.
content:
SBI PO exam pattern is similar to other bank PO exams with bank-specific weightages.

Prelims (100 marks, sectional timing)

  • English Language
  • Quantitative Aptitude
  • Reasoning Ability

Mains – Objective

  • Reasoning & Computer Aptitude
  • Data Analysis & Interpretation
  • General / Economy / Banking Awareness
  • English Language

Mains – Descriptive

English (Letter / Essay) typed on computer.

Phase-III includes psychometric test (qualifying) and Group Exercise & Interview. Official structure: SBI Careers advertisement PDF.
